newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's Banque du Sud raises capital.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's Banque du Sud raises capital.

text.p: Tunisia's Banque du Sud on Monday said it has completed raising its capital from 50 million dinars to 75 million dinars.
It said its offer of 4.4 million new shares has been fully subscribed.
BS provisional net profits for the first half of 1996 amounted to 4.233 million dinars, up from 4.047 million dinars during the same period last year.
The state-controlled bank has among its shareholders Italian bank Monte Dei Paschi Di Siena.
BS in 1995 raised its capital to 50 million dinars from 30 million dinars.
